fusions.name: Sudden Reel
fusions.desc: Snaps a strand out that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Pond Burst
fusions.desc: Bursts strands out round you, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Sudden Spring
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. Using it increases your movement speed by 15% for 3s.

fusions.name: Lily Mooring

riders.text: you cross it faster than you cross ground
and nothing that has to wade can reach you

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 10% faster over it, from silver your stamina recovers 15% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.
